faq.subtitle: Most questions about billing are answered on the right. For anything else, reach the team directly or start the free month and see the product for yourself.
faq.replyTime: Usually replies within a day at contact@stallio.shop

domain.question: Do I need my own domain or hosting?
domain.answer: No. Every shop gets a hosted stallio.shop/you link the moment you sign up, nothing to buy or configure.

payments.question: How does Stallio handle payments?
payments.answer: You set your own method, bank transfer, payment link, or cash on delivery, and Stallio tracks the status of every order for you.

limits.question: Is there a limit on products or orders?
limits.answer: No limit on either, on both plans. List one item or one thousand, and every order still lands in your dashboard.

freeMonthEnds.question: What happens when the free month ends?
freeMonthEnds.answer: We'll remind you a few days before it ends. Pick monthly or yearly to keep your shop live, or cancel with nothing owed.

switchPlans.question: Can I switch between monthly and yearly?
switchPlans.answer: Yes, anytime from your account settings. Your storefront and data carry over exactly as they were.

everythingIncluded.question: Do both plans really include everything?
everythingIncluded.answer: Yes. Monthly and yearly unlock the identical storefront, dashboard, and tools, yearly simply costs less over time.
